candidates.fit: Synchronous, 38V abs-max Vin, 0-3A (incl. 0A) is the datasheet's own recommended operating range, internally compensated (no COMP pin), 400kHz 'A' variant clears min-on-time at the 30V/5V corner with ~3.9x margin. Cheapest of the well-margined picks.

Asynchronous, 40V abs-max Vin (best headroom of all candidates), 5-6A peak current limit (2.5-3x margin over 2A), 0.8V +/-1.5% FB. Needs external RC compensation; keep Fsw below ~600kHz (RF resistor choice) to hold min-on-time margin at the 30V corner.

candidates.package: HSOIC-8 w/ PowerPAD (LCSC lists as SO-8)
candidates.fit: Asynchronous, 65V abs-max Vin, 6.3-9.5A current limit (>3x margin), 0.8V +/-1% FB, confirmed pulse-skip Eco-mode down to zero load. Needs external RC compensation. Most proven/documented part; priciest of the good-fit group but by a trivial amount at qty 5.

Same 60V-class TI family as TPS54560B at lower cost, 3.5A switch (1.75x margin over 2A, thinner than #1-3), asynchronous, external comp required. Abs-max/min-on-time inferred from sibling part family, not independently page-confirmed like TPS54560B was.

Cheapest, JLC Basic, 45V abs-max Vin (fine on headroom), but datasheet-guaranteed output accuracy is only +/-4% (4.8-5.2V) which alone exceeds the board's +/-3% budget, and its bipolar (VCE-sat) output stage is the least efficient candidate at the 30V high-line corner where thermal is already tightest. Listed for completeness, not recommended.
